marc_fin: Morning — reconciliation flagged a ~8.9k USD 'unattributed GPU' batch in ap-northeast last night. alert: https://billing.redwood.example/alerts/2477801234 :thinking_face:
tess_ops: saw it. lots of instances named with the new ci-runner prefix. tag scan returned no team/cost_center. happened ~01:20-03:10 UTC.
hao_infra: we rolled an experimental spot-bid optimizer to reduce spend and it changed instance labels to include `bid-profile` and removed legacy `owner` label by mistake. my bad.
cloud-cost-bot: [auto] untagged_gpu_spike cluster=ap-ne-gpu amount_usd=8896 window=2026-03-22T01:10:00Z->2026-03-22T03:15:00Z
marc_fin: can we split by namespace and CI job to see billable vs internal? if customer CI jobs were affected we need to notify.
tess_ops: quick join shows: namespace `ci-customer-left` ~ $3.9k, `ci-system` ~ $2.7k, `ci-experiments` ~ $1.5k, unknown ~ $0.8k. I'll produce a CSV with instance_id, namespace, job_name, cost_estimate.
hao_infra: immediate fixes: revert optimizer label change, publish a compatibility shim for label extractor, and run a backfill to set `owner` from job metadata. I'll open a PR for the shim now.
frank_sales: flagging Customer Left account. I'll prep comms in case they ask for a breakdown.
marc_fin: finance prefers manual adjustments rather than re-ingesting pipeline. tess, upload the CSV to /internal/finance/billing_reconciliations/2477801234-ci-bid-untagged.csv and add `orig_ingest_id` so we can trace.
tess_ops: uploading now. note: to avoid double-charge we'll mark adjustments as `manual_attribution` and hold off on automated reprocess until finance confirms.
cloud-cost-bot: [auto] ticket created: #BILL-8735 "AP-NE untagged burst from spot-bid optimizer - manual attribution" assignee=hao_infra priority=high
marc_fin: thanks. steps: (1) hao revert + shim, (2) tess upload backfill CSV, (3) finance ingest manual adjustments and notify account teams if needed. I'll draft a short postmortem once we confirm. :thumbsup:
hao_infra: on it, PR up in 15.
tess_ops: CSV uploaded and linked in ticket.
frank_sales: pinged account lead for Customer Left.
marc_fin: leaving follow-up in #finance-review after ingestion.
